page.title: Projects
page.empty_hint: Choose a repository and an execution squad to get your first issue moving.

detail.description_hint: Shared with agents as context for every task in this project.
detail.empty_issues_hint: Create a new issue or assign existing ones to this project.

resources.local_daemon_offline_hint: Start the local daemon to attach a directory on this machine.
resources.local_daemon_already_attached_hint: This machine already has a local directory attached. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_no_daemon_tooltip: Local daemon isn't reporting an ID yet — the agent can't open this directory.
resources.local_other_machine_tooltip: Only available on the machine that registered this directory.
resources.chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
resources.chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each task hands its work back as an agent/… branch.
resources.toast_local_already_attached: This directory is already attached to the project on this machine.
resources.toast_local_daemon_already_attached: This machine already has a local directory attached to this project. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_validate_unsupported: Local directories can only be picked on the desktop app.
resources.mode_dialog_title: How should tasks use this folder?
resources.mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether tasks on this folder can run at the same time.
resources.mode_in_place_description: One task at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
resources.mode_worktree_description: Tasks run at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to run tasks in parallel — it would quietly run them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_edit_tooltip: Change how tasks use this folder
resources.mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Tasks run at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
resources.toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode

delete_dialog.title: Delete project
delete_dialog.description: This will delete the project. Issues will not be deleted but will be unlinked.

execution_squad.label: Execution squad
execution_squad.unavailable_hint: This squad or template is unavailable to you. Choose another.
execution_squad.catalog_failed: Could not load squad templates. Try again when the connection is restored.
execution_squad.existing_runtime_hint: Uses the squad’s current runtime. Its availability will be checked on the project.
execution_squad.prepare_hint: Creates the missing roles and skills and keeps existing customizations. No project issue starts until you submit it.
execution_squad.choose_runtime_hint: Choose a runtime now, or connect one later. Your squad choice will be saved.
execution_squad.local_runtime_hint: Only runtimes on a machine with a project directory are available.
execution_squad.wrong_machine_hint: The squad’s actual execution machine cannot access this project’s local directory. Choose a matching squad or review its runtimes.
execution_squad.none_hint: Choose a squad to handle this project’s next issue.
execution_squad.needs_runtime_hint: Your project and squad choice are saved. Connect a runtime, then finish setup.
execution_squad.offline_hint: Connect the squad’s execution machine before handing it an issue.
execution_squad.ready_hint: Describe the next issue. Review the trigger preview before creating it.
execution_squad.future_only: This changes defaults for future issues. Existing issues keep their assignees.
execution_squad.save_failed: Could not save the squad choice. Try again.

errors.agent_name_conflict: A role name is already in use. Rename the conflicting agent or choose an existing squad.
errors.agent_access_denied: You do not have access to a required agent. Choose a squad you can use.
errors.agent_unavailable: A required agent is unavailable. Restore it or choose another squad.
errors.runtime_unavailable: The selected runtime is unavailable. Connect it or choose another.
errors.runtime_mismatch: Existing squad members use another runtime. Review the squad’s runtimes or choose another squad.
errors.squad_unavailable: This squad is missing, archived, or unavailable to you. Choose another.
errors.preparation_failed: Your project is saved. Squad setup could not finish. Retry setup or choose another squad.

execution_squad.runtime_load_failed: Could not load runtimes. Your selection is kept; try again when the connection is restored.
